actors.description: Secret key of the Lumen Trail Supply Co. test-mode account: no restricted-key permissions attribute, so every resource group is writable; every operation granted.
Restricted key 'reporting-bot' with read permission on every resource group: reads succeed, every write fails PERMISSION_DENIED (403) inside the Tool; every operation granted by the framework.
Restricted key 'revoked-key' with an empty permissions object: every operation fails PERMISSION_DENIED (403) inside the Tool although the framework grants all of them.
Live-mode secret key: objects are stamped livemode=true and Stripe's test payment method ids (pm_card_*) do not resolve.
An actor without any grant: the framework denies every operation before the Tool runs (Stripe-shaped 403).
